items.summary: Two tracked source files in this host's GPU_IPC clone (GPU_IPC/cuda_to_hip.h, GPU_IPC/details/device_utils.inl) have been modified and uncommitted since 2026-08-14, so the recorded Windows build evidence describes no commit. The change replaces the function-like warp-intrinsic macros with equivalent WARP_* functions, because ROCm's own headers declare real overloads of those names and the macros mis-parse them. Semantics are unchanged (still pinned to 32 lanes) and no call site uses the CUDA spellings, so it is neutral for the two validated Linux platforms -- but committing it advances head_sha off 3798cb2 and drops linux-gfx90a and linux-gfx1100 from completed to revalidate, while the only platform that needs it (windows-gfx1151) is blocked on the CrowdStrike host defect. Commit and accept the revalidation, or revert the clone: a person's call.
